nu-map/documentation / src/

src/ Application source

All application source code. Six layers that depend only inward: UI consumes Context, Context drives Core and Data, institution-specific behavior is isolated behind the ports/adapters boundary. Everything except src/config.js is institution-agnostic.

Parent
nu-map root
Entry
main.jsx → App.jsx
Provider order
ThemeProvider → InstitutionProvider → LanguageProvider → PlannerProvider

Layer map

contracts
ports/
11 JSDoc-only files. No logic. Define exactly what each institution adapter must provide. The seam between institution-specific and institution-agnostic code.
implementations
adapters/
All institution-specific values and rules. northeastern/ is the reference implementation. generic/ provides safe fallbacks. wire() composes them.
state bridge
context/
Four React contexts: InstitutionContext (adapter injection), LanguageContext (i18n), PlannerContext (all planner state), ThemeContext (CSS vars).
pure logic
core/
Eight modules of pure domain logic. No React, no I/O, no adapter imports. Semester grid, prereq eval, graduation checking, plan helpers, themes.
I/O layer
data/
Three modules: majorLoader + minorLoader (Vite lazy-import from src/data/majors/), persistence (localStorage read/write). Course loading belongs to the ICourseCatalog adapter.
UI layer
ui/
13 React components. No prop drilling — all shared state comes from usePlanner(). All styles inline with var(--token) CSS variables.

Layer dependency rules

graph LR UI["ui/\n13 components"] CTX["context/\nInstitutionContext\nLanguageContext\nPlannerContext\nThemeContext"] CORE["core/\npure functions"] DATA["data/\nI/O only"] PORTS["ports/\nJSDoc contracts"] ADAPT["adapters/\nnortheastern/\ngeneric/"] UI -->|"usePlanner()\nusePort()\nuseLanguage()"| CTX CTX -->|"pure fn calls"| CORE CTX -->|"async I/O\n(ports as params)"| DATA ADAPT -->|"implements"| PORTS CTX -->|"wire()\nusePort()"| ADAPT style UI fill:#ddf4ff,stroke:#0969da style CTX fill:#fbefff,stroke:#8250df style CORE fill:#dafbe1,stroke:#1a7f37 style DATA fill:#fff8c5,stroke:#9a6700 style PORTS fill:#fef3c7,stroke:#d97706 style ADAPT fill:#ffe4e6,stroke:#e11d48
Imports go inward only. Core and Data never import from adapters or React. UI never imports from adapters directly — always via usePort().

App.jsx — composition root

src/main.jsx is 4 lines — it mounts React in StrictMode. App.jsx wraps the entire app in four nested providers in this exact order:

// src/App.jsx — required nesting order
<ThemeProvider storagePrefix={institutionAdapter.institution.storagePrefix}>
  <InstitutionProvider adapter={institutionAdapter}>
    <LanguageProvider>
      <PlannerProvider>
        <PlannerApp />
      </PlannerProvider>
    </LanguageProvider>
  </InstitutionProvider>
</ThemeProvider>

Why this order: ThemeProvider is outermost because it reads storagePrefix directly from the adapter object (a plain import, not via React context). InstitutionProvider is second because LanguageProvider and PlannerProvider both call usePort() internally — they need InstitutionContext in the tree above them. LanguageProvider wraps PlannerProvider because the planner may eventually need t() for localized messages.

PlannerApp (defined in App.jsx) renders the actual layout. It uses a ResizeObserver to compute uiScale and applies transform: scale(uiScale) to the app container so all pixel values in components can be written at one canonical desktop width.

config.js — the one file to change for a fork

// src/config.js
import { wire }              from './adapters/wire.js';
import northeasternOverrides from './adapters/northeastern/index.js';

export const institutionAdapter = wire(northeasternOverrides);

This is the only non-adapter file that knows which institution is active. Changing line 2 to point at a different adapter folder reconfigures the entire planner — semester structure, gen-ed framework, co-op rules, course catalog URL, disclaimers, and credit units — all from a single edit.
